Are your PSIR answers actually answering what UPSC is asking?

In this lecture, Chandan Kumar Sir focuses on how to approach PSIR answers with better clarity, structure and analytical depth. The session sets the stage for Indian Political Thinkers, helping aspirants understand how to study and use thinkers effectively in their answers.

The Mains Master Program (MMP) 2027 by LevelUp IAS is designed for aspirants who want to systematically complete their UPSC Mains GS preparation instead of postponing it until after Prelims.

With 100+ structured classes covering GS Paper 1–4 and Essay, live answer writing three days a week, PYQ integration, current affairs and value addition, and revision-ready notes, MMP 2027 brings the different components of Mains preparation together.

The programme follows a structured timeline from August to January, helping aspirants work towards becoming Mains-ready before the Prelims phase takes over.

Mains Master Program 2027 — LevelUp IAS
Complete GS 1–4 + Essay | 100+ Classes | Live Answer Writing | PYQ Integration | Current Affairs & Value Addition
